first-idea.name: Fikraddii ugu horreysay
first-idea.line: Wada hadalkii ugu horreeyay, intaan koodh jirin.
first-board.name: Looxii ugu horreeyay
first-board.line: Loox raacaya dhismihiisa: kaararka, tiirarka, jiid oo dhig, mashruucyada.
team-roles.name: Koox iyo doorar
team-roles.line: Astaamaha wakiilada, qaabdhismeedyada kooxaha, meelaha iyo yaa maxay qabanaya.
install.name: Rakibid iyo daabacaado
install.line: Zip uu saaxiib rakibi karo, is-cusboonaysiin, kanaalo iyo dib u noqosho.
usage-saver.name: Badbaadiyaha isticmaalka
usage-saver.line: Cabbir waxa socodku ku kacaan, koodhka khafiif ka dhig, xadkaaga badbaadi.
friends.name: Asxaab iyo wadaagid
friends.line: Fariimo gaar ah, gudbiye qarsoon, casuumaado, doorar iyo mashruucyo la wadaago.
languages.name: Luqadaha
languages.line: Qoraal shaashad kasta faylka luqadda, Holandays iyo Flemish marka hore.
ai-tester.name: Tijaabiyaha AI
ai-tester.line: Tijaabiye ayaa marka hore hubiya gacan-ka-gacan kasta oo muujiya waxa uu arkay.
website.name: Mareegta
streaming.name: Sheeko iyo tooska
streaming.line: Discord, Twitch, OBS, habka tooska, GIF-yo iyo emoji.
no-ai.name: Nooca aan AI lahayn
no-ai.line: Loox dadka aan AI la'aan koodhka qorin, iyo looxyo dadweyne.
night-watch.name: Ilaaliyaha habeenka
night-watch.line: Ilaaliye iyo Scrum Master ayaa kooxaha shaqada ku haya inta aad hurdo.
p-more.name: Wax kale oo dhan
p-more.line: Fikrado yar oo wali sugaya inay noqdaan kuwa xiga.
p-android.name: Taleefan iyo Android
p-android.line: Looxaaga ka gaar taleefanka, kadibna abka Android ee asalka ah.
p-release.name: Alpha iyo wixii ka dambeeya
p-release.line: Alpha xiran, bogga tooska ah, kadibna beta.
p-languages.name: Luqado dheeraad ah
p-languages.line: In ka badan boqol luqadood iyo hab quusid ah oo loogu talagalay barteyaasha.
p-engines.name: Mishiinno AI dheeraad ah
p-engines.line: Dooro Claude, Codex ama Gemini wakiil kasta.
p-pro.name: Hab-dhaqan xirfadeed
p-pro.line: Calaamado khatar, albaabada isku-darka, kaararka dhacdooyinka iyo ilaalin.
p-self.name: Ku daryeelidda adiga
p-servers.name: Serfarro iyo ballaarin
p-servers.line: Dejinta serfarka guud, doorar iyo qorsheynta kobaca.
p-livestream.name: Dheeraadka tooska
p-livestream.line: Sheekada Twitch, emoji gaar ah iyo muuqaal tooska ah oo dadweyne.
